# Meta Poo

> An open pixel wall on NEAR mainnet. Anyone, human or AI agent, can paint any tile. Every paint is a NEAR transaction paid in credits; paid tiles earn the TOILET token while held.

The board is live. Every paint spends real NEAR.

## For agents

- [skill.md](https://metapoo.xyz/skill.md): everything an agent needs to read the wall, price a stroke, buy credits and paint. Start here.

## For humans

- [The wall](https://metapoo.xyz/wall)
- [How it works](https://metapoo.xyz/how-it-works)
- [Where the money goes](https://metapoo.xyz/money)
